-- Audit Log Summary - Simplified
-- Only includes existing tables (4 Bronze, 4 Silver, 5 Gold)
SELECT
  'Bronze' AS pipeline_layer,
  table_name,
  total_rows,
  rescued_rows AS flagged_count,
  rescued_pct AS flagged_pct,
  severity_level,
  check_timestamp
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      'assessments_bronze' AS table_name,
      COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN _rescued_data IS NOT NULL THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) AS rescued_rows,
      ROUND(
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN _rescued_data IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
          * 100.0
          / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
      ) AS rescued_pct,
      CASE
        WHEN
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN _rescued_data IS NOT NULL THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) < 5
        THEN
          'Acceptable'
        WHEN
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN _rescued_data IS NOT NULL THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) BETWEEN 5 AND 10
        THEN
          'Warning'
        ELSE 'Unusable'
      END AS severity_level,
      MAX(ingestion_timestamp) AS check_timestamp
    FROM
      oulad.oulad_bronze.assessments_bronze
    UNION ALL

-- Silver Layer Data Quality Validation
-- Tracks cleaned data quality, nulls, and transformations across all Silver tables
WITH silver_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'assessments_silver' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN id_assessment IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS null_key_count,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          weight < 0
          OR weight > 100
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS invalid_weight_count,
    MAX(ingestion_timestamp) AS last_ingestion,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS check_timestamp
  FROM
    oulad.oulad_silver.assessments_silver
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'courses_silver' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          code_module IS NULL
          OR code_presentation IS NULL
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS null_key_count,
    0 AS invalid_weight_count,
    MAX(ingestion_timestamp) AS last_ingestion,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS check_timestamp
  FROM
    oulad.oulad_silver.courses_silver
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'student_assessment_silver' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          id_assessment IS NULL
          OR id_student IS NULL
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS null_key_count,
    0 AS invalid_weight_count,
    MAX(ingestion_timestamp) AS last_ingestion,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS check_timestamp
  FROM
    oulad.oulad_silver.student_assessment_silver
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'student_vle_silver' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          id_student IS NULL
          OR id_site IS NULL
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS null_key_count,
    0 AS invalid_weight_count,
    MAX(ingestion_timestamp) AS last_ingestion,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS check_timestamp
  FROM
    oulad.oulad_silver.student_vle_silver
)
SELECT
  table_name,
  total_rows,
  null_key_count,
  invalid_weight_count,
  null_key_count + invalid_weight_count AS total_flagged,
  ROUND((null_key_count + invalid_weight_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_rows, 0), 2) AS flagged_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (null_key_count + invalid_weight_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_rows, 0) < 5
    THEN
      'Acceptable'
    WHEN
      (null_key_count + invalid_weight_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_rows, 0) BETWEEN 5 AND 10
    THEN
      'Warning'
    ELSE 'Unusable'
  END AS severity_level,
  last_ingestion,
  check_timestamp
FROM
  silver_metrics
ORDER BY
  table_name

    MAX(ingestion_timestamp) AS last_ingestion,

      CASE

)

  table_name

  ROUND(SUM(flagged_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_rows), 0), 2) AS layer_flagged_pct,
  SUM(

-- BP1: How does student engagement relate to performance?
-- Aggregates VLE engagement and assessment performance independently to the enrollment
-- grain, combines them through the shared dimension key, then buckets students into
-- engagement quartiles to show how performance outcomes shift across engagement levels.

WITH engagement AS (
    SELECT
        student_enrollment_id,
        SUM(sum_click)                 AS total_clicks,
        COUNT(DISTINCT interaction_date) AS active_days
    FROM oulad.oulad_gold.fact_student_engagement
    GROUP BY student_enrollment_id
),

performance AS (
    SELECT
        student_enrollment_id,
        AVG(score)                      AS avg_score,
        SUM(weighted_score)              AS total_weighted_score,
        COUNT(student_performance_key)   AS assessment_count
    FROM oulad.oulad_gold.fact_student_performance
    GROUP BY student_enrollment_id
),

combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(e.student_enrollment_id, p.student_enrollment_id) AS student_enrollment_id,
        COALESCE(e.total_clicks, 0)      AS total_clicks,
        COALESCE(e.active_days, 0)       AS active_days,
        p.avg_score,
        p.total_weighted_score,
        p.assessment_count
    FROM engagement e
    FULL OUTER JOIN performance p
        ON e.student_enrollment_id = p.student_enrollment_id
),

-- 1. Bucket students into engagement quartiles (relative, since raw click counts
--    have no natural business threshold the way credit loads do in BP2)
engagement_tiers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_clicks) AS engagement_quartile
    FROM combined
),

-- 2. Summarize performance outcomes by engagement tier
engagement_performance_summary AS (
    SELECT
        CASE engagement_quartile
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Q1 - Lowest Engagement'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Q3'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Q4 - Highest Engagement'
        END AS engagement_tier,
        COUNT(*)                           AS student_count,
        ROUND(AVG(total_clicks), 1)        AS avg_clicks,
        ROUND(AVG(active_days), 1)         AS avg_active_days,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_score), 2)           AS avg_score,
        ROUND(AVG(total_weighted_score), 2) AS avg_weighted_score
    FROM engagement_tiers
    WHERE avg_score IS NOT NULL   -- only students with assessment data can show a performance outcome
    GROUP BY engagement_quartile
)

-- Primary query output: performance outcomes by engagement level
SELECT *
FROM engagement_performance_summary
ORDER BY engagement_tier

-- BP2: What patterns appear among students who withdraw?
-- Analyzes demographic, academic, and behavioral patterns of withdrawn students
WITH withdrawal_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    se.student_enrollment_id,
    se.student_id,
    se.course_id,
    se.final_result,
    se.num_of_prev_attempts,
    se.studied_credits,
    se.date_unregistration,
    s.gender,
    s.region,
    s.highest_education,
    s.imd_band,
    s.age_band,
    s.disability
  FROM
    oulad.oulad_gold.dim_student_enrollment se
      LEFT JOIN oulad.oulad_gold.dim_student s
        ON se.student_id = s.student_id
),
engagement_before_withdrawal AS (
  SELECT
    e.student_enrollment_id,
    SUM(e.sum_click) AS total_clicks,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.interaction_date) AS active_days,
    MAX(e.interaction_date) AS last_activity_date
  FROM
    oulad.oulad_gold.fact_student_engagement e
  GROUP BY
    e.student_enrollment_id
)
SELECT
  w.final_result,
  w.gender,
  w.region,
  w.highest_education,
  w.imd_band,
  w.age_band,
  w.disability,
  w.num_of_prev_attempts,
  w.studied_credits,
  COUNT(*) AS student_count,
  AVG(COALESCE(e.total_clicks, 0)) AS avg_clicks,
  AVG(COALESCE(e.active_days, 0)) AS avg_active_days,
  AVG(w.date_unregistration) AS avg_unregistration_day
FROM
  withdrawal_cohort w
    LEFT JOIN engagement_before_withdrawal e
      ON w.student_enrollment_id = e.student_enrollment_id
GROUP BY
  w.final_result,
  w.gender,
  w.region,
  w.highest_education,
  w.imd_band,
  w.age_band,
  w.disability,
  w.num_of_prev_attempts,
  w.studied_credits

SELECT
  e.week_id,
  w.week_number,
  p.phase_name,
  w.phase_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_enrollment_id) AS active_students,
  SUM(e.sum_click) AS total_clicks,

GROUP BY
  e.week_id,
  w.week_number,
  p.phase_name,
  w.phase_id
ORDER BY
  w.week_number

  *

      'Record Count' AS check_name,
      COUNT(*) AS actual_count,

      0 AS duplicate_count,
      CASE

    UNION ALL
    SELECT

      COUNT(*) AS actual_count,

        CASE

      0 AS duplicate_count,
      CASE

          SUM(

                OR code_presentation IS NULL
